verdict.rationale: Pipecat is documented as an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework. A hands-on probe confirmed it pip-installs and runs keylessly, and the docs state the same bot file is portable to 'most production self-hosting setups', with distribution across processes and machines. The included development runner is explicitly not for production, so production self-hosting relies on the user's own server setup, and the pack has no detailed production self-hosting guide. Missing for 10: a dedicated production self-hosting guide (container/orchestration and scaling on own infrastructure), and independent reports of production self-hosted deployments.
